heading_path: 21.20G  Registrar must notify parties of dismissal or discontinuance of opposition
text: If an opposition is dismissed or discontinued, the Registrar must notify the parties of the dismissal or discontinuance.
title: Registrar must notify parties of dismissal or discontinuance of opposition

units.text: If an opposition is dismissed or discontinued, the Registrar must notify the parties of the dismissal or discontinuance.
